data.one_liner: Extension methods and classes built on top of RxDart like Single and StateStream.
data.what_it_does: Extends RxDart with specialized reactive types such as Single for one-shot operations, and StateStream with synchronous latest-value access and distinct until changed behavior. It provides operators for streams and helpers for state management.
use_when: You are using RxDart and need a Single type for one-shot asynchronous computations.
You want broadcast state streams with synchronous access to the latest value and automatic distinct checking.
You want advanced stream operators like flatMapSingle, distinctBy, and asNullable.
avoid_when: You do not use RxDart or reactive programming in your application.
You prefer standard Flutter setState or simple ValueNotifiers for state management.
strengths: Adds useful stream operators and classes missing from core RxDart.
Provides Single type suited for API calls and single-emission asynchronous tasks.
StateStream and StateSubject fit well with the BLoC pattern and StreamBuilder.
weaknesses: Requires learning additional custom Rx types and concepts alongside RxDart.
Dart 3 class modifiers strictly restrict subclassing or implementing certain core classes outside their libraries.
